rows.headline: Supreme Court rules on conditions for revoking property gifts

rows.summary: The Supreme Court ruled that a gift deed of property can be revoked if the donor included a specific condition that the recipient must provide maintenance. This decision clarifies the legal protections available to senior citizens regarding property transfers to family members. It establishes a clear pathway for elderly donors to reclaim assets if their basic needs are neglected by the donee.
